acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: When guest host Tobin Low was looking for a husband, he got opposing advice from two of the most important people in his life, his mom and his best friend.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Zarna Garg had a clear plan for how she was going to find a husband. Things did not go as she expected.
acts.title: 10 Things I Require About You

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: People who fall in love at first sight often describe it as a kind of magic. One of our producers, Aviva DeKornfeld, is skeptical of these sorts of claims. And also a little envious.
acts.title: Crazy Stupid Love

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Calvin is an 11 year old who is learning what love is all about, the hard way.

songs.t: Breaking Up is Hard to Do

acts.title: He’s All That

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: Writer Marie Phillips believes that magic is not just reserved for the beginning of a relationship. In fact, she says the real magic can be found in the end, once you decide to finally leave.
acts.title: How To Leave a Guy in 10 Days

acts.label: Coda
acts.desc: Tobin Low tells us which camp he falls in — math or magic.

songs.a: Pilot & “You + Me = Love” by Undisputed Truth (radio only)
